definitions.explanation: Short, usually curved tube pasta. In Japan it is associated above all with マカロニサラダ and with gratin rather than with Italian-style sauced dishes.

examples.japanese: マカロニサラダを{作|つく}った。
マカロニを{塩水|しおみず}でゆでる。
examples.english: Boil the macaroni in salted water.

examples.japanese: {給食|きゅうしょく}のマカロニグラタンは、{子|こ}どもたちに{一番|いちばん}{人気|にんき}のある{献立|こんだて}だった。
examples.english: Macaroni gratin was the most popular item on the school lunch menu with the children.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マカロニサラダ: macaroni salad
- マカロニグラタン: macaroni gratin
- マカロニをゆでる: to boil macaroni

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パスタ: pasta — the general term
- ペンネ: penne — straight tubes with diagonally cut ends
- スパゲッティ: spaghetti — long and thin
- マカロン: macaron — a different word entirely (the French confection), easily confused in katakana
